title: Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Scope of this role**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly analytical Financial Planning \& Analysis Partner II to join our finance team. The Financial Planning \& Analysis Partner II will primarily assist with financial forecasting, budgeting, modeling, and variance analysis to support strategic decision\-making across the organization. The ideal candidate should have strong financial modeling skills, data analytics skills, and excellent communication abilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
- Drive the monthly forecasting and annual planning related activities which include the following:

* Planning \& Budgeting; current year and mid/long\-term rolling corporate estimates and forecasts including cash forecasting. Serve as a thought leader to drive process improvement and create documentation to set precedence.
* Performance tracking against operating plans and KPIs; identifying risks and opportunities, driving accountability.
* Business intelligence, insight identification, and decision analytics for business partners and executive teams.
* Execute financial close and reporting processes in partnership with controllership, commercial, and accounting teams. Also, look for opportunities related to process improvement and drive change.
* Analyze financial performance, highlight trends and variances against budget and forecast with qualitative comments. Variance analysis of actuals vs forecast with key highlights/call outs to the management.
* Foster strong relationships with stakeholders, promoting effective communication and collaboration
* Lead and partner with cross\-functional business teams in delivering analytics, data, and insights to drive key business decisions and support negotiations.
* Actively partner with global leaders to drive standardization, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Actively drive automation of reporting at the corporate level; support the FP\&A organization through an end\-to\-end enterprise transformation.


**A Little About You**
 A successful FP\&A Analyst should be detail\-oriented, and have a strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify and strengthen areas of business risks. They should help develop and maintain the right reporting models (completeness and accuracy) and adapt to business needs/strategic and growth mindset. This requires a lot of diligence and an attitude to take on new tasks while being solution\-oriented.
   

  

* Strong work ethic, self\-motivated work style, attention to detail, effective communicator
* Ability to organize multiple responsibilities and deliver results in an accurate and timely manner while adapting to changes in priorities.
* Ability to influence and strategically partner with individuals of various educational and technical backgrounds, both inside and outside the organization
* Strong business acumen and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and present data
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines under pressure
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and follow\-up skills.


**Qualifications**
* Qualified CA or MBA in finance from Tier 1 or Tier 2 colleges
* Prior FP\&A Experience required (2\-5 years minimum) FP\&A/ reporting/data analytics experience across revenue, expense, cash or capex.
* Sound fundamentals on financial knowledge, analytical/data modeling ability, and sound understanding of the media ecosystem including some understanding of Nielsen’s products and services
* Ability to develop constructive relationships with executives and colleagues across the organization
* Experience with analytics tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Google Data Studio, and spreadsheet tools (excel, Google Sheets) is required.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Manager- Finance FP&A
description:
This is a core Financial Planning \& Analysis role housed within the CEO Office \& Strategy team. You will own the planning, forecasting, performance\-reporting and profitability agenda for the business, and act as the financial conscience in leadership discussions – the person who can say, with evidence, what the numbers mean and what should be done about them.
   

  

 The role is deliberately hands\-on and full\-stack. You will build the models, write the queries, design the dashboards, close the variance analysis and then present the story to the CEO and leadership team. It combines classic FP\&A depth with modern data tooling, and it requires someone who is as comfortable in a DAX measure and a SQL join as in a P\&L, a cash flow and a month\-end close.
   

  

 Given the exposure to confidential financial information and the technical accounting judgement involved, a qualified Chartered Accountant is a mandatory requirement for this position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& Planning**
* Own the annual operating plan and budget end to end – timelines, templates, assumption sets, bottom\-up build\-up with function heads, consolidation, review cycles and final leadership sign\-off.
* Run the rolling forecast process (monthly / quarterly) covering revenue, gross margin, operating cost, EBITDA, working capital and cash, with clear documentation of assumptions and bridges to the prior view.
* Build and maintain driver\-based financial models that link operational volumes and activity to financial outcomes, rather than growing lines by a percentage.
* Prepare long\-range plans and multi\-year business projections to support strategic, capacity and investment decisions.
* Run scenario, sensitivity and what\-if analyses (best / base / downside) and quantify the financial impact of strategic options for leadership.
* Performance Reporting, Variance \& Business Partnering
* Own the monthly MIS and management reporting pack – P\&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPI dashboards and management commentary – delivered accurately and on the committed calendar.
* Perform detailed budget\-versus\-actual and forecast\-versus\-actual variance analysis; explain movements by driver (volume, price, mix, cost, phasing) and not merely by line item.
* Act as finance business partner to sales, operations, delivery and support functions – challenge spend, validate business cases and help function heads manage to plan.
* Prepare material for monthly and quarterly business reviews, board packs, investor updates and lender or auditor requirements.
* Maintain an early\-warning view on performance risks and opportunities, and drive corrective action with the relevant owners.
* Profitability, Cost \& Cash
* Analyse profitability at every meaningful cut – project, product, customer, channel, region, service line – and identify where value is being created and destroyed.
* Build and refine unit economics, contribution margin and cost\-to\-serve models; support pricing, discounting, bidding and make\-versus\-buy decisions with quantified analysis.
* Drive cost control and efficiency initiatives: opex and overhead analysis, vendor and category spend review, headcount and manpower cost planning, and tracking of savings actually realised.
* Monitor working capital – receivables, payables, inventory and advances – and support cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning.
* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals and new investments using NPV, IRR, payback and ROCE; track post\-implementation performance against the approved case.
* Accounting Workflows, Close \& Controls
* Work closely with the accounts and controllership team through the month\-end and year\-end close – accruals, provisions, cut\-off, cost allocations and revenue recognition – to ensure reported numbers are complete and correct.
* Apply a strong working understanding of end\-to\-end accounting workflows (order to cash, procure to pay, record to report, fixed assets, payroll) when interpreting, reconciling and challenging data.
* Reconcile management reporting to the statutory books and clearly explain the bridge between the two.
* Ensure reporting and analysis respect applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IFRS as relevant), internal control requirements and audit expectations.
* Support statutory audit, internal audit, tax and compliance requirements with analysis, schedules and explanations as required.
* Strategy \& CEO Office Support
* Convert open\-ended questions from the CEO and leadership into structured analyses with clear, defensible recommendations.
* Prepare business cases, decision notes and financial evaluations for new initiatives, markets, partnerships and organic or inorganic growth opportunities.
* Track strategic priorities and enterprise KPIs across functions, flag deviations early and drive closure with business owners.


**Candidate RequirementsQualifications – Mandatory**
* Essential: Chartered Accountant (CA) – qualified and in good standing. This is a non\-negotiable requirement; applications without CA qualification will not be considered.
* Essential: Minimum 5 years of post\-qualification experience in FP\&A, business finance, management reporting, controllership or a CEO / MD office finance role.


**Technical Skills**
* Essential: Full\-cycle FP\&A ownership – budgeting, rolling forecasting, variance analysis, MIS, profitability analysis and driver\-based financial modelling.
* Essential: Strong command of accounting standards, month\-end close processes and the link between management and statutory reporting.
* Essential: Practical understanding of relational data structures, keys, joins and granularity
* Essential: Confident presentation skills in PowerPoint for board, investor and leadership audiences.
* Preferred: Hands\-on experience with Oracle (NetSuite) ERP
* Preferred: Experience in a multi\-entity, multi\-currency or multi\-geography reporting environment.


**Behavioural Attributes**
* High ownership – takes a problem from question to answer to action with limited direction.
* Rigorous attention to detail; a number presented to leadership must be right and must be defensible.
* Commercial mindset – interprets numbers in terms of business decisions, not just accounting outcomes.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain financial analysis to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Able to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively, without direct authority.
* Absolute discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial and business information.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and short turnaround requests.


**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**
* The annual budget and rolling forecast run on a clear calendar, with assumptions documented and forecast accuracy improving cycle over cycle.
* There is visibility on cost leaks and a clear action plan to address those
* The monthly MIS closes on time, reconciles to the books and is explained by driver rather than by line item.
* Leadership reviews run on a single, automated and trusted set of dashboards instead of competing spreadsheets.
* Profitability by project, customer and service line is visible, understood and actively managed.
* Recurring manual reporting effort is materially reduced through better data models and automation.

title: Head of Treasury
description:
Head – Treasury
 



  





 Job Purpose
 



 The Head – Treasury will own the company's overall treasury strategy, including funds mobilisation from domestic and international debt markets, investment of surplus liquidity, and management of interest rate, currency, and liquidity risk.
 



 The role is accountable for optimising the cost of funds, ensuring robust liquidity and ALM management, maintaining full regulatory compliance, and building deep relationships with banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, rating agencies, and other market participants.
 



 The role leads the entire Treasury function and is a key member of the Finance leadership team, working closely with the CFO on funding strategy, capital structure, and Board/ALCO reporting.
 



 Other Quantitative / Qualitative Parameters \- Financial
 


* Cost of Borrowing (COB)
* Cost of Funds (COF)
* Borrowing mix
* Investor diversification
* LCR/ALM support
* Overall Treasury P\&L impact



 Research
 


* Interest rate outlook
* Market dynamics
* Peer/competitor benchmarking



 External Agencies
 


* Banks
* Mutual Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Corporates
* Financial Institutions/DFIs
* Exchanges
* Depositories
* Rating Agencies
* Trustees



 Job Context \& Major Challenges
 



 Treasury at Bajaj Auto Credit Limited is responsible for mobilising and deploying funds at optimal cost, managing asset\-liability risk, maintaining regulatory liquidity buffers (LCR), hedging interest rate and currency exposure, and sustaining relationships with a broad base of lenders and investors, all while supporting the growth of the company's lending book.
 



 The Head – Treasury owns this mandate end\-to\-end: setting the borrowing strategy in consultation with the CFO, leading negotiation and closure of funding transactions across NCDs, CPs, bank lines, and ECBs, and building a resilient, diversified funding base that can flex with business growth.
 



 The role also carries full accountability for the team's output, for regulatory and audit compliance, and for representing Treasury at ALCO, RMC, and Board levels.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Funding Strategy and Market Execution
* Own the overall borrowing strategy and calendar, in consultation with the CFO.
* Mobilise funds through private placement/public issue of NCDs and CPs, and through bank lines.
* Raise External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) from overseas lenders and DFIs, maintaining strong global banking relationships.
* Time market entry to minimise cost of borrowing; track interest rate movements, credit spreads, and investor appetite.
* Decide and adjust the borrowing mix (short vs. long tenor, bank vs. market) to meet cost and diversification objectives.



 Relationship Management and Investor Diversification
 


* Build and sustain senior\-level relationships with banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, corporates, FIs, and international lenders.
* Continuously widen and deepen the investor base across domestic and international markets.
* Manage the rating agency relationship and credit rating review process.



 Liquidity and Investment Management
 


* Direct investment of surplus funds in G\-Secs, T\-Bills, and other approved securities to meet LCR requirements.
* Work with the ALM/Cashflow teams to plan liquidity, minimise negative carry, and optimise returns on surplus funds.



 Risk Management and Hedging
 


* Own the interest rate and currency hedging strategy (OIS, IRS, futures, and other derivatives) for the borrowing book.
* Ensure MTM, valuation, and reporting of the debt and investment portfolio are accurate and timely.
* Build and maintain a robust risk management framework covering credit, market, and liquidity risk.



 Team Leadership and Operations
 


* Lead, mentor, and manage the Treasury team (Debt Markets, Investments, Treasury Operations).
* Oversee end\-to\-end execution, settlement, and documentation of all borrowing and investment transactions per SOPs.
* Drive automation and digitisation of Treasury systems and processes.



 Compliance and Governance
 


* Ensure full compliance with RBI, SEBI, FEMA, NHB, and FIMMDA guidelines applicable to Treasury operations.
* Ensure Treasury is fully prepared for statutory, internal, and concurrent audits.
* Present funding, investment, and risk positions to ALCO, RMC, the Board, and senior management.
* Provide accurate data for central MIS (COB, COF, budgets, projections).



 Critical Skill Sets
 


* Strong background in financial modelling and analysis.
* Deep expertise in domestic and international debt capital markets.
* Strong track record reading and acting on interest rate and market movements.
* Demonstrated leadership managing a mid\-to\-large treasury/finance team.
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder\-influencing skills, including at CXO/Board level.
* Strong existing network across banks, DFIs, mutual funds, and rating agencies.



 Major Challenges in the Role
 


* Securing funds at optimal cost in volatile domestic and global markets.
* Balancing currency, interest rate, and liquidity risk across a growing book.
* Reading market direction early enough to act on it.
* Structuring innovative funding solutions (securitisation, structured debt, bond arbitrage) where standard instruments fall short.
* Continuously diversifying the investor base to avoid concentration risk.

* NAV \& Reporting: shadow the daily NAV process \& monthly trial balance reconciliation and help prepare operational reports.
* Records and reports the status of daily and monthly operational delivery.

* Training on Enfusion and industry\-standard platforms — CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, DTCC ALERT, and EMIR reporting tools.
* Mentorship from experienced fund operations professionals across reconciliation, NAV accounting, and trade lifecycle management.
* A front\-row seat to how a SOC 1 Type II controlled operating environment is run in practice.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Business Management, or a related quantitative field.

**Who We Are**
 Sanctuary is building something most real estate companies aren't even trying to build: wellness\-focused, nature\-integrated home communities across the Texas Hill Country, designed around the idea that where you live should make you healthier, calmer, and more connected. And now we're scaling the capital engine behind it.
   

  

 This is a company in build mode. You'd be joining early enough to shape how we finance growth for years to come, not stepping into a process that's already set in stone.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an Associate to structure and execute debt for our US real estate portfolio \- construction, bridge, and permanent financing across multifamily, commercial, and ground\-up development. This is not a corporate credit, project finance, or loan servicing role: every transaction you'll work on is tied to a specific US property, and you'll be underwriting, structuring, and negotiating real loans against real collateral, not modeling hypotheticals.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Capital Lead and work closely with our CEO to determine how we finance and scale our real estate pipeline.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Deal structuring \& execution: Underwrite and structure construction, bridge, and mezzanine financing for specific US assets. Take term sheets apart and put them back together to win on pricing, leverage, and flexibility.
* Capital modeling: Build the models that drive real decisions — DSCR, LTV, LTC, IRR, debt yield, stress\-tested against rate moves, lease\-up delays, cost overruns.
* Capital stack strategy: Recommend how we fund specific projects, balancing cost of capital against risk and timeline.
* Lender relations \& syndication: Be a real point of contact for US lenders and institutional capital partners. Run the diligence process and drive facilities to close.
* Portfolio surveillance: Own the debt maturity ladder across the portfolio and keep every DSCR, LTV, and LTC covenant in view before it becomes a problem.


**What You Bring**
* 3–8 years in real estate capital markets, real estate private equity, CRE lending, or real estate investment banking.
* A specific US commercial real estate deal you can walk us through in detail, the property, the structure, the numbers you calculated, and why.
* Excel and Google sheets mastery, including built debt waterfalls; VBA or Power Query is a strong plus.
* Real working knowledge of US credit agreements, loan documentation, and institutional underwriting standards for real estate.
* The ability to turn dense underwriting into a memo an executive can act on in five minutes.
* Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time.


**Not the right fit if:** 
 your background is loan servicing, reconciliation, back\-office operations, or ratings/research without direct property\-level underwriting. We'd rather point you toward a role that's a better match than waste your time or ours.
   

  

**Why join now**
* Real stakes, real speed. You're not modeling hypotheticals \- you're advising directly on how we move millions of dollars to build communities that are already going up.
* A seat at the table. Direct exposure to senior leadership and the institutional lenders who fund our growth.
* Build the function, not just the deals. We don't have a Senior Capital Markets hire yet \- you'd be the first person to lay the groundwork for how this function works at Sanctuary.
* Total ownership. We hand you real runway to improve how we underwrite and close, not a script to follow.
* Mission you can feel. You're financing homes designed to make people's lives measurably better \-v not another spec subdivision.
